sourceFacts.scope: authenticated service client; retained reader; unchanged framing, deadlines, sequence and failure certainty

regression.condition: whole ACK available on first read; second underlying read fails at deadline
regression.after: complete matching ACK from one underlying read
regression.additionalCoverage: prefetched next response retained; truncated header rejected; existing fragmented/foreign/failed ACK tests

limitations: The g471 trace measures client observation, not kernel arrival or native worker scheduling.
The exact cause of the 992174us first-read delay remains unproven.
Buffering removes a redundant kernel read when bytes are available; genuine fragmented or lost responses still fail safely.
No post-change physical-device latency or stability claim has been made.
